lines.text: Many learners say: Where is the consent for my phone?
Better: Where is the outlet for my phone?
Consent means yes. An outlet gives power.
Outlet! Where is the outlet for my phone?

data.wrong: Where is the consent for my phone?
data.right: Where is the outlet for my phone?
data.why: Consent means yes. An outlet gives power.

en.tip: Consent means agreement. A power socket is an outlet. Say “Where is the outlet for my phone?”
en.caption: Do you say “Where is the consent for my phone?” in English? 😅 Consent means agreement in English, and the place on the wall for a plug is an outlet! “Where is the outlet for my phone?” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
